questions.question: Does enqueue_block_editor_assets run on the public front-end of a block (FSE) theme?

options.label: No — it's editor-only, even in a block theme
Only if the theme explicitly requests it

feedback.correct: Correct. It never fires on the front-end, block theme or not. For assets needed in both places, use enqueue_block_assets instead.
feedback.incorrect: It's editor-only, full stop — even a block (FSE) theme's front-end never triggers this hook. Use enqueue_block_assets for shared assets.
